AI Overview
Flag Guesser
Video game
Flag Guesser is an interactive web-based geography and flag trivia game available at Flag Guesser that tests your knowledge of national flags, coats of arms, and regional insignia from around the world. 
flagguesser.com
Game Features & Categories
Global Coverage: Tests national and regional symbols across Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America, and global dependencies.
Regional Categories: Includes specialized quizzes for US states and territories, UK counties, Australian and Canadian states, German states, and Japanese prefectures.
Ranking: Features a Hall of Fame ranking system to track high scores and progress. 
flagguesser.com
(Note: If you are looking for the browser-based 1v1 multiplayer game where flags are revealed tile-by-tile, you can check out Flag Reveal Multiplayer, or try the fast-paced web quiz Flags on Poki.)
